q23.

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (line 33), with per-driver equivalents at `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` (line 32) and `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` (line 32)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go` (`type Memo struct` at line 35)
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`message Memo` at line 198)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`export type Memo` at line 79)

Two notes on the boundaries: the `payload` column is itself a nested proto (`store.MemoPayload`, generated into `proto/gen/store`) referenced by the Go model's `Payload` field, and the SQL layer is duplicated three times because each database driver keeps its own `LATEST.sql` schema plus versioned migration files under `store/migration/<driver>/`.
